lanes.summary: Diff changes inference::KVCache::new and OptimizedKVCache::new to allocate each layer via a per-call closure (0..num_layers).map(...).collect() instead of vec![vec![0.0;n];layers], eliminating the clone-commits-every-byte bug (#4769-class). This matches the precedent "#4778 form" already used in layers/model.rs KVCache::new verbatim (same closure idiom and comment lineage). FALSIFY-KV-005 is extended to cover both new constructors at 1 GiB/8-layer sizing with the existing < 64 MiB (LIMIT_KIB) threshold, consistent with the other three cache types already in that test. OptimizedKVCache's v_cache allocation order changed from hidden_dim*max_seq_len to max_seq_len*hidden_dim, but multiplication is commutative so total allocated length and all downstream indexing (store/get) are unaffected — no behavior change. A roadmap entry (PMAT-4783.yaml) was added matching the ticket's acceptance criteria. No scope creep found: only the two constructors, the test, and the roadmap doc were touched.
